text_block_list.text:
"...Is that so... That must have been painful...
...Yes............right............"

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
“...That's a relief, then...
...Well then... please take care...”

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
...It's already this late.
I have to get back—
It seems fatigue has built up in Manhattan Cafe from staying up night after night listening to "something" talk...
